text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
While you have a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] You may digivolve 1 of your Digimon into a Digimon card with [Dex] or [DeathX] in its name from your trash for its memory cost.

text_sections.label: Security Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.

qa.answer: No, this effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card from your trash that meets the digivolution requirements and has [Dex]/[DeathX] in its name.
qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into any Digimon card from my trash as long as it has [Dex]/[DeathX] in its name?

qa.answer: Yes, as long as the activation conditions are met.
qa.question: Can I activate an effect that reduces the digivolution cost when digivolving using this card's [Main] effect?
